entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks and algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering and dimensionality reduction
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning models with SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks with Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow
Large language modeling and generative AI applications
Natural language processing, text analytics and recommender systems
Computer vision, image and video processing and object recognition
Transfer learning in NLP with LangChain, Hugging Face and PyTorch
reading.format: Delivered as a 13 course series with hands-on labs and projects, including practical evaluations on real world datasets. Available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 13 course series that teaches learners to build, train and deploy machine learning and deep learning models, including large language models. It covers libraries such as SciPy, ScikitLearn, Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow, and includes hands-on labs and projects. Completing it produces a career credential and portfolio work intended to demonstrate AI engineering skills to employers.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and other technical specialists who want to become job ready as an AI engineer. It is listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
